description: This is a Python source file defining the LLMSwitcher class, which manages switching between different LLM (Large Language Model) services at runtime using specified strategies. It includes methods for inference, function registration, and managing active LLMs.

classes.name: LLMSwitcher
classes.description: A pipeline class that switches between different LLMs at runtime, allowing inference and function registration across multiple models.

methods.name: __init__(self, llms: List[LLMService], strategy_type: Type[StrategyType])
methods.description: Initializes the LLMSwitcher with a list of LLM services and a switching strategy class.

methods.name: List[LLMService] llms(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the list of LLM services managed by this switcher.

methods.name: Optional[LLMService] active_llm(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the currently active LLM service.

methods.name: Optional[str] run_inference(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Performs inference asynchronously on the active LLM with a given context.

methods.name: register_function( self, function_name: Optional[str], handler: Any, start_callback=None, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a function handler for all LLMs managed by this switcher.

methods.name: register_direct_function( self, handler: DirectFunction, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a direct function handler for all LLMs managed by this switcher.
